page0.text:
...If there's a way for him to be saved.
If there's a way to resolve this without killing, is it so wrong to wish for it?
I don't mind being called naïve.
And I know I'm a hypocrite.

page1.text:
To a Master, defeating your opponent means killing them.
They're all aware of this fact before getting themselves involved thus far.
They chose to fight knowing they will have to kill or be killed trying.
I know how much of a coward I am for wanting to step in and stop them from fighting.

page2.text:
And yet...
If I had already decided to fight for someone, to help someone, then I can't afford to lose a life when that life can be spared.

page3.text:
"...Stop! The fight is over, you don't have to fight anymore!"
I try to stop them while enduring my headache.
In that moment.
Kuzuki makes his move.

page4.text:
"Wha..."
Maybe my move gave him an opening. Kuzuki shortens the distance between him and Archer in an instant, and strikes right between his eyes.
